name: Laneboard
tagline: Project board for small teams to plan and track work
description: For small teams that want to see what everyone is working on and notice when too much is in progress. It keeps several projects on custom lanes with work-in-progress limits, and every move or delete can be undone.
scope: Lanes with limits and drag and drop
Filters, undo, JSON export and import
features: Pointer-event drag and drop for cards and lanes with mouse or touch, plus a keyboard Move to menu
Work-in-progress limits with a tick gauge, an over-limit lane state and a line drawn where the limit was passed
Card details with assignee, labels, priority, due date, checklist progress and a timestamped activity log
Filters that combine text, assignee, label and overdue, and keep hidden cards in place when you drag
Month calendar of due dates, sortable table view, and an archive with restore
Undo for moves, deletes and archiving, plus validated JSON export and import
engineering: Drag and drop is written directly on pointer events, and moves are stored as 'insert before this card' so a drop under an active filter lands correctly among cards the viewer can't see, with each move undone by an inverse operation rather than a snapshot.
